content.text: That format works — completing the rest of the orders.

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H2","instruction_en":"Tape an A4 sheet upright on the lower door frame next to the wooden threshold in the walkthrough doorway and re-take the photo.","instruction_zh":"請在走道門口木門檻旁的下門框上，直立貼一張A4紙，重新拍照。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H3","instruction_en":"Remove the red patterned rug in the walkthrough or flatten it and tape its edges to the floor against the wall.","instruction_zh":"請將走道靠牆處的紅色花紋地毯收走，或鋪平並將邊緣貼牢固定。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H4","instruction_en":"Move the black cable off the rug and wooden doorway threshold in the walkthrough and secure it out of the walkway.","instruction_zh":"請將走道上橫跨地毯和木門檻的黑色電線移開走道，並固定收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H5","instruction_en":"Pick up the black cable with plug from the tiled hallway floor in the walkthrough and store it away from the walkway.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地上斜放的黑色插頭電線拿起，收放到走道以外的地方。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H6","instruction_en":"Pick up the light-colored lace-up sneakers from the tiled floor in the walkthrough and put them in a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地上的淺色綁帶運動鞋拿起，放到鞋櫃裡。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H7","instruction_en":"Pick up the light-colored sneakers from the floor in the walkthrough and put them in a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將走道地板上的淺色舊運動鞋拿起，放到鞋櫃裡。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H8","instruction_en":"Pick up the dark blue slippers from the tiled floor in the walkthrough and put them in a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地上的深藍色拖鞋拿起，放到鞋櫃裡。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H9","instruction_en":"Pick up the dark blue slide slippers from the tiled floor in the walkthrough and put them in a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地上的深藍色便鞋拖鞋拿起，放到鞋櫃裡。"}
